title: IBM RFID Commercial-The Future Supermarket
summary: A 2006 IBM commercial depicting a future supermarket where shoppers walk out and RFID automatically charges them for their items.
why: HN commenters cite it as proof that walk-out shopping was envisioned long before Amazon's version, and as an appealing vision of the future.

quote.text: IBM viewed this tech seriously enough to be marketing it to the public in 2006.
